description: This file defines the 'Attribute' class within the OpenCart admin event system, handling hooks after attribute edit and delete operations to enqueue tasks for updating related product information.

classes.name: Attribute
classes.description: Represents event handlers for attribute edit and delete actions, triggering associated tasks.

methods.name: editAttribute
methods.description: Handles post-edit hook for attributes, enqueuing tasks to update product info.

methods.name: deleteAttribute
methods.description: Handles post-delete hook for attributes, enqueuing tasks to update product info.
